text: At the fair there were 10 people in line for the bumper cars. If 2 of them got tired of waiting and left and 2 more got in line, how many people would be in line?
A fast food restaurant sells two sizes of fries, small and large. On Friday they sold 24 fries total. If 4 of the fries sold were small, what is the ratio of large fries sold to small fries sold?
Rob also compared the Empire State Building and the Petronas Towers. What is the height difference between the two if the Empire State Building is 443 m tall and the Petronas Towers is 452 m tall?
Rob also matched the London Eye which stands at 443 ft and Las Vegas' High Roller standing at 550 ft. Being the tallest Ferris wheel in the world, how much taller is High Roller than the London Eye?
After a week, Sofia did a survey to ask if the students liked the new menu. She found out that 235 students liked the new menu while 165 didn't. How many students took part in Sofia's survey?
The Hawks scored three touchdowns worth 7 points each. How many points do they have?
The two groups will also collect garbage from all the 453 houses in the city. If Lizzie's group covered 238 houses while the other group covered 190, how many more houses remain?
Tiffany was buying hand towels for her house. She bought 9 packs with each pack having 3 towels in it. How many towels did she buy?
They had 119 matchboxes wrapped in colorful shiny wrappers. If they are to distribute the matchboxes equally to the 9 houses in the first block, how may matchboxes will each house receive?
The ratio of boys to girls in a kindergarten is 2:3. If the number of boys is 12, find the number of girls.
The sanctuary also includes several swamp areas where most of the reptiles usually reside. If there are 4 swamps, each having 356 different reptiles, how many reptiles are living in the swamp areas?
If you add 45 to a mystery number you will get 92. What is the mystery number?
The area of square photo is 25 square inches. Angie decided to enlarge the photo by doubling the sides. What will the new area be?
The length of the rectangular building is 7 ft more than its width. If the perimeter of the building wall is 98 ft, find its length and width.
Next on his list is the city's Orphanage for Young Girls. He bought roses, lilies, sunflowers and daisies. If he bought 40 pieces of each flower, how many flowers did the orphanage receive?
A comic book costs 37 cents. The store owner reversed the digits by mistake. He wrote that number on the comic book. How much did the store owner overcharge his customer?
4 birds are sitting on a branch. 1 flies away. How many birds are left on the branch?
The train left for the station at 9:45 and arrived at 10:00. How long did it take?
An international group had 49 Chinese, Americans and Australians. 16 of them were Americans and 11 of them were Australians. How many Chinese were there?
Mrs. Hilt saw 2 dogs and 2 chickens. How many animal legs did she see?
Isha's pencil is 22 inches long. If she sharpens two inches off on Monday and two inches on Tuesday, how long will her pencil be then?
172 students are forming teams for a mountaineering competition. Each team should have 18 students. How many students will not be on a team?
Lisa went on a 52 km. She divided the distance traveled evenly over 4 days. How many meters did Lisa walk each day?
A restaurant added a new outdoor section that was 4 feet wide and 6 feet long. What is the area of their new outdoor section?
While playing a trivia game, Team A scored 2 points, Team B scored 9 points and Team C scored 4 points. How many points were scored total?
Mrs. Hilt bought 3 pizzas for $8 each. What was the total amount she paid for the three pizzas?
There were 51 geese in the farmer's field. 28 of the geese flew away. How many geese were left in the field?
To get to school, Jenny decided to ride the school's double decker bus. The bus has a total of 20 rows of seats and each row has a capacity of 4 kids. How many kids in total can ride the school bus?
During the first 6 hours of the fair there were the following number of customers: 58, 58, 62, 55, 49 and 48. What is the mean of the number of customers?
Amy had 180 video games. If she placed the games into 9 different stacks, how many games would be in each stack?
Third-grade students went to a concert in 8 buses. Each bus took 45 students. How many students went to the concert?
Mother bought some potatoes. She used 15 of the potatoes to make salads and 24 of the potatoes for mashed potatoes. If there were 13 potatoes left, how many potatoes did mother buy at first?
There are 9 students in the class and 27 Skittles. If the Skittles are divided equally among the students, how many does each student get?
Cheryl and Lori started a lemonade stand on Friday. They bought 85 plastic cups. They sold a lot of lemonade and only had 18 cups left. How many cups did Cheryl and Lori use?
A buffet offers ranch or caesar dressing. The ratio of ranch dressing used to caesar dressing used is 7:1. If the buffet uses 28 cases of ranch dressing, how many cases of caesar do they use?
You want to share 34 pencils among 6 friends. How many would each friend get?
Johnny practiced for the track team and ran 3 laps per minute. How many minutes did it take Johnny to run 10 laps?
After paying 6 dollars for the pie, Sandy has 57 dollars left. How much money did she have before buying the pie ?
At a bake sale there were 104 items sold total. If 48 of the items sold were cookies and the rest were brownies, what is the ratio of brownies sold to cookies sold?
Mrs. Hilt spent 74 cents at the school store. She bought a notebook for 35 cents, a ruler for 18 cents, and 3 pencils. What is the cost of one pencil?
Then he started to prepare the games. If each game takes 5 minutes to prepare and he prepared a total of 5 games, how many minutes did it take for Andrew to prepare all the games?
When they arrived at HappyLand, they immediately went in and bought their tickets. If each ticket cost $17.00 and they bought 8 tickets, how much did they spend on tickets?
Ben draws a circle inside a square piece of paper whose area is 400 square inches. He makes sure than the circle touches each side of the square. What is the area of the circle?
If Simon needs to make 519 gift bags at a rate of 42 bags per day, how many days does he need to finish making all the gift boxes?
Kyle bought 3 presents. The first present cost $18. The second present cost $7 more than the first. The third present cost $11 less than the first. How much did Kyle pay for all 3 presents?
Lucy has an aquarium with 212 fish. She wants to buy 68 more fish. How many fish would Lucy have then?
The sum of present age of Abe and the age before 7 years is 31. Find the present age of Abe.
A bicycle and a bicycle helmet cost 240 dollars. How much did each cost, if the bicycle cost 5 times as much as the helmet?
While shopping, Maria bought 35 green towels and 21 white towels. If she gave her mother 34 of them, how many towels did Maria end up with?
Harry walked along the beach and collected 34 sea stars, 21 seashells and 29 snails. He lost some of the items and had 59 items left at the end of his walk. How many sea creatures did he lose in all?
The second angle of a triangle is five times as large as the first. The measure of the third angle is 12 degrees greater than that of the first angle. How large are the angles?
I have 3 hundreds, 8 tens, and 3 ones. What number am I?
One zoo guide spoke to a group of 19 children. Another guide spoke to a group of 25 children. There are 22 guides at the zoo. How many children did the zoo guides speak to?
Tiffany was playing a video game and had 43 lives. In a hard part of the game she lost 14 lives. If she got 27 more lives in the next level, how many lives would she have?
A sandbox is 312 centimeters long and 146 centimeters wide. How many square centimeters of ground does the sandbox cover?
There were 86 pineapples in a store. The owner sold 48 pineapples. 9 of the remaining pineapples were rotten and thrown away. How many fresh pineapples are left?
2 beavers were working on their home. 1 went for a swim. How many beavers are still working on their home?
Andy had 31 baseball cards. His dad gave him some more. Then Andy had 50 baseball cards. How many baseball cards did Andy get from his dad?
There is a snail problem in Centerville. People work together to get rid 3,482 snails, but 8,278 of them remain. About how many snails were originally in Centerville?
There are 250 vitamins in a bottle. Gil takes 12 vitamins per day. How many vitamins short of his usual 12 vitamins is Gil on the day the bottle runs out?
Two clocks are turned on at the same time. One clock chimes every 15 minutes. The other clock chimes every 25 minutes. In how many minutes will they chime together?
George is 8 years more than Christopher and Ford is 2 years younger than Christopher. The sum of their ages is 60. Find the ages of George, Christopher and Ford.
A box can hold 18 pieces of chalk. If there are 3,484 pieces of chalk, how many chalks are there in the box that is not full?
Tara can row downstream 20 km in 2 hours, and upstream 4 km in 2 hours. Find her speed of rowing in still water and the speed of the current.
Mrs. Hilt spent 1 hour and 30 minutes shoveling snow on Saturday morning and 45 minutes shoveling snow on Saturday afternoon. How much total time did she spend shoveling snow?
For the school bake sale Amy made pastries. She baked 15 cupcakes and 48 cookies. After the sale she had 12 to take back home. How many pastries did she sell?
A state seal, which is round, hangs in the capitol building. It has a diameter of 2 meters. What is the seal's area?
Payton leaves to go on an 85 minute bike ride at 3:27 p.m. Payton's family eats dinner at 5:45 p.m. How much time will Payton have between finishing her bike ride and eating dinner?
The difference between two numbers is 26 and greater number is three times the smaller. Find the numbers.
Matthew and Billie went apple picking. Matthew found 46 big, red apples. Billie found some as well. Together they found 80 apples. How many apples did Billie find?
Anna has a total of 28 nickels and dimes in her piggy bank. She has 8 fewer nickels than dimes. How many dimes does Anna have?
Girl Scout cookies come packed 12 boxes to a case. Scout Deborah sold 31 boxes of Lemon Chalet Cremes. How many boxes will not be packed to a case?
Carey and Pat are moving chairs to the gym. They agreed to move 74 chairs. Carey moved 28 chairs. Pat has moved 29 chairs. How many more chairs do they have left to move?
Two boys have 480 marbles between them. One arranges them in heaps of 6 marbles and the other in heaps of 9 each. If the total number of heaps is 72, how many marbles does each have?
Recently, the postal service sold stamps with famous people pictured on them. They sold 578,833 color stamps, as well as 523,776 black-and-white ones. About how many stamps did they sell?
Adam earned 9 dollars for each lawn he mowed. If he had 12 lawns to mow, but forgot to mow 8 of them, how much money did he actually earn?
The sum of two numbers is 35. Their difference is 13. Find the numbers.
One day, Trent and his friends had lunch while sitting at tables of 2. Another day, they had lunch at tables of 8. What is the smallest number of people that could be in the group?
86 students are going hiking. Each school- bus can take 9 students. How many school-buses are needed?
Length of a rectangle is 8 m less than twice its width. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 56 m, find its length and width.
Steven and Megan shared some marbles in the ratio 3:4. Megan received 24 marbles. How many marbles did Steven get?
At the carnival, the ratio of people who won the ring toss game to lost it was 4:1. If 28 people won, how many people would have lost?
At the school Halloween party 2 girls and 9 boys dressed as ghosts. How many people total dressed as a ghost?
A rectangle has an area of 360 square centimeters. It is 20 centimeters long. What is its perimeter?
At the store beef jerky was $34.23 for 3 pounds. If you bought 7 pounds, how much would it cost?
An electronics store had 163 video games. If they put them on shelves with 84 on each shelf, about how many shelves would they need?
Adam had 33 books. If he sold 11 of them and used the money he earned to buy 23 new books, how many books would Adam have?
Michelle also noticed that she was able to save a few $50 dollar bills. If she has a total of 7 pieces of $50 dollar bills, what is the total value of all her $50 bills combined?
Todd has some gum. Steve gave him 16 more pieces of gum. Now Todd has 54 pieces of gum. How many pieces did Todd have to start with?
In a game you start with 2 lives. If you got 6 extra lives in the first level and 11 more in the second, how many lives would you have?
